g.title: NPC_QSP
g.text: Niemann-Pick Disease Type C (NPC) — Quantitative Systems Pharmacology map
Niemann-Pick Disease Type C · Quantitative Systems Pharmacology map

The plasma markers read the visceral (liver · spleen) store, while the disease that kills the patient sits in the cerebellum — the two compartments differ in drug access, in turnover and in reversibility
) — this one line of structure is what separates a symptomatic drug from a disease-modifying one

g.title: cluster_gene
g.text: genotype → foldable protein · arimoclomol's entry point

g.title: cluster_egress
g.text: the primary lesion of the disease · NPC2→NPC1 hydrophobic hand-off

g.title: cluster_homeo
g.text: the store overflows while the ER starves — the SREBP2 paradox

g.title: cluster_sphingo
g.text: miglustat's entry point · the sphingosine-first hypothesis

g.title: cluster_calcium
g.text: 6. Lysosomal Ca²⁺ store · TRPML1 · membrane fusion
the upstream lesion that sphingosine creates (Lloyd-Evans 2008)

g.title: cluster_autophagy
g.text: failure to degrade the substrate is what accumulates in the neuron

g.title: cluster_mito
g.text: oxidation of the accumulated cholesterol is what makes the biomarkers

g.title: cluster_biomarker
g.text: 9. Biomarker generation — the readout of the visceral compartment
an oxidation product of the liver · spleen store, not the state of the cerebellum

g.title: cluster_neuron
g.text: 11. The neuronal compartment — cerebellar Purkinje cells
the real stage of the disease · anterior→posterior lobe gradient of loss

g.title: cluster_tau
g.text: a lysosomal disease in which Alzheimer-type neurofibrillary tangles appear

g.title: cluster_inflam
g.text: feedback that amplifies neuronal loss (an amplifier, not a cause)

g.title: cluster_reserve
g.text: ★ the core structure of the model — the point at which a symptomatic effect parts from a disease-modifying one

g.title: cluster_miglustat
g.text: oral 200 mg tid · GCS inhibition · reduces the influx flux

g.title: cluster_arimoclomol
g.text: oral tid · HSF1 co-induction → folding yield of mutant NPC1↑ (genotype dependent)

g.title: cluster_nal
g.text: oral up to 4 g/day · t½ ~1 h · rapid symptomatic effect + metabolic improvement

g.title: cluster_cd
g.text: direct extraction that bypasses NPC1 · efficacy and ototoxicity are the same mechanism

g.title: cluster_emerging
g.text: gene therapy · HDAC inhibition · TRPML1 agonists

g.title: cluster_hetero
g.text: 21. Patient heterogeneity — the age-of-onset form is a function of residual activity
the same structure, a different f_NPC1 → an entirely different phenotype

g.title: cluster_trialdesign
g.text: each drug was tested in a design that can only see the mechanism it assumed

g.title: MUT_NPC2
g.text: loss of the lysosomal luminal carrier

g.title: EGRESS_PM
g.text: Direct delivery to the plasma membrane

g.title: CHOL_STORE->CHOL_CNS
g.text: the same mechanism in the neuron

g.title: LIVER_FAIL
g.text: (cause of death in the early infantile form)

g.title: CC_THIN
g.text: Corpus callosum · white matter microstructural damage

g.title: PC_STRESS->PC_HEALTHY
g.text: recoverable if the burden is removed

g.title: PSYCH
g.text: Psychiatric symptoms (first presentation of the adult form)

g.title: DAM_NODE
g.text: DAM = ∫ S dt — no repair term

g.title: GATE_NODE
g.text: death begins only where DAM > D_reserve

g.title: LATENCY
g.text: → genotype sets the age of onset

g.title: GATE_NODE->PC_LOST
g.text: death begins (once the gate is open)

g.title: SATRATE
g.text: Rate saturates once the gate is passed
→ the slope is independent of the age of onset

g.title: POWER_REV
g.text: A short window = sensitive only to the reversible component

g.title: POWER_IRREV
g.text: A long window + change from baseline
= cannot separate a constant offset from a slope

g.title: NAL_DOSE
g.text: by body weight · up to 4 g/day (divided)

g.title: NAL_VEST->F_REV
g.text: reduces the reversible component only, at once

g.title: CD_IV->CHOL_VISC
g.text: the IV route reaches only the viscera

g.title: CD_EXTRACT
g.text: Direct extraction of cholesterol from the membrane

g.title: CD_OTO
g.text: Cholesterol depletion in outer hair cells

g.title: WITHDRAW
g.text: Whether it worsens again after withdrawal
= the only design that separates the two components
